edition.publication: American reprint of the Edinburgh edition, revised and chronologically arranged with brief prefaces and occasional notes (Buffalo: Christian Literature Publishing Company, 1886)
edition.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume V: Fathers of the Third Century

alternate_titles: Fathers of the Third Century: Hippolytus, Cyprian, Caius, Novatian, Appendix
work.author: Alexander Roberts, James Donaldson, and A. Cleveland Coxe
work.description: The fifth volume of the American Ante-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Hippolytus, the works and letters of Cyprian of Carthage, the fragments of Caius, and Novatian in nineteenth-century English translation. Its container identity remains distinct from the works and translated editions printed within it.
work.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume V
